comment.body: Thanks for the bug report and the follow-up. This still looks like the same random runner-exit family tracked in Issue 50169, so I would consolidate the investigation there rather than split it across multiple threads. One useful detail from this report is that the automated triage spotted malformed settings JSON while loading several modules, so that clue should travel with any future `/bugreport` or preview-build retest results added to Issue 50169.
